title: clinvar.ingestion.completed
description: Producer: clinvar-service (app/kafka_producer.py's IngestionCompletedEvent, ADR 0019). newReleaseId replaces ADR 0018's original releaseId field name for symmetry with previousReleaseId; changedKeys is the ADR 0019 addition that lets api invalidate its cache without re-reading a tabix file itself.
